name: Tōyō (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Tōyō town emblem in white: an outlined ring open at the fly with a stylised device at the top, like a letter C.
history: Municipal flag of Tōyō, a town in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 17 November 1964.

features.role: Tōyō town emblem — an outlined ring open at the fly with a stylised device at the top, like a letter C
